import csv, os, shutil
from decimal import Decimal

src = '/app/documents'
inv_dir = '/app/invoices'
other_dir = '/app/other'
os.makedirs(inv_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(other_dir, exist_ok=True)

invoices = {
    '2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg': ('6558.00', '0.00'),
    'T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf': ('4031.00', '0.00'),
    'UsN9tVTKskms.pdf': ('896.00', '0.00'),
    'wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf': ('440.00', '0.00'),
    'JOiylq2_7S18.jpg': ('6860.45', '623.68'),
    'KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg': ('9963.00', '0.00'),
    'ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg': ('819.06', '74.46'),
    'lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg': ('797.91', '72.54'),
    'vvK89XK847m3.jpg': ('6204.19', '564.02'),
    'w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg': ('44745.59', '4067.78'),
}

files = sorted(os.listdir(src))
for name in files:
    s = os.path.join(src, name)
    if not os.path.isfile(s):
        continue
    if name in invoices:
        shutil.move(s, os.path.join(inv_dir, name))
    else:
        shutil.move(s, os.path.join(other_dir, name))

total_sum = sum((Decimal(v[0]) for v in invoices.values()), Decimal('0'))
vat_sum = sum((Decimal(v[1]) for v in invoices.values()), Decimal('0'))

with open(os.path.join(inv_dir, 'summary.csv'), 'w', newline='') as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['filename', 'total_amount', 'vat_amount'])
    for name in sorted(invoices):
        w.writerow([name, invoices[name][0], invoices[name][1]])
    w.writerow(['total', f'{total_sum:.2f}', f'{vat_sum:.2f}'])

print('moved files:', len(files))
print('total_amount:', total_sum)
print('vat_amount:', vat_sum)
